title: Harry Hayden & Lelia Bliss with Baby, 1920s Sepia Snapshot, California
description: A vintage candid sepia snapshot featuring Hollywood character actors Harry Hayden and Lelia Bliss posing proudly with their newborn son, Donny, in a woven outdoor bassinet. The setting showcases classic Spanish Colonial Revival architecture with stucco walls, red tile roofing, and a palm tree, characteristic of Los Angeles in the late 1920s. Annotations on the front name the family members, while handwritten notes on the reverse mention their maid, Minnie.
